text.en:
The special provisions of the Retirement Gratuity Fund and the Terminal Leave Benefits Fund
created under Presidential Decree No. 233 are hereby amended to include the officials and employees of the
Bureau of Public Highways among the authorized beneficiaries of the funds appropriated therein.

The effectivity of this decree shall retroact as of July 1, 1973.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
